stages.title: Site Survey & Rooftop Feasibility
stages.description: Physical inspection of rooftop area, shadow analysis, azimuth/tilt evaluation, and existing electrical load/meter audit.

checklist.task: Rooftop dimensions and usable area measured
Shadow obstacles (water tanks, parapets, nearby trees) documented

stages.title: System Design & 3D Engineering
stages.description: Preparation of 3D shadow modeling layout, string calculation, Single Line Diagram (SLD), and customer blueprint sign-off.

stages.title: DISCOM / Net-Metering Application
stages.description: Application submission to state electricity board (DISCOM) or PM Surya Ghar portal for grid feasibility & subsidy authorization.

checklist.task: Solar application submitted on DISCOM portal
Required KYC & electricity bill documents submitted
Grid feasibility approval obtained from subdivision engineer

stages.title: Material Procurement & Delivery
stages.description: Dispatch of Tier-1 solar modules, string inverter, galvanized mounting structure, DC cables, and ACDB/DCDB protection boxes to site.

checklist.task: Inverter serial number verified against warranty
Customer signature received on delivery challan

stages.title: Mechanical Structure Assembly
stages.description: Civil anchoring, chemical chemical fasteners / base plates, hot-dip galvanized structure erection, and panel clamping.

checklist.task: Anchor bolts fastened with waterproofing sealant
Structure tilt angle adjusted (optimal seasonal degree)
Solar modules clamped securely (mid & end clamps)

stages.title: Electrical Cabling & Inverter Setup
stages.description: DC string wiring in conduits, AC/DC distribution boxes, inverter wall mounting, lightning arrestor (LA), and 3 earthing pits installation.

checklist.task: UV-resistant solar DC cables routed in HDPE conduits
Inverter mounted in shaded, ventilated area
Dedicated earthing pits installed (Inverter, DC, LA)

stages.title: DISCOM Inspection & Net-Meter Install
stages.description: Joint inspection with electricity board officer, verification of anti-islanding safety features, and installation of bidirectional net meter.

stages.title: Commissioning, App Setup & Handover
stages.description: Grid synchronization, live solar generation verification, customer mobile app Wi-Fi monitoring configuration, and warranty handover.

checklist.task: Mobile monitoring app configured on customer phone
